diagnosis: Round 2 global scan found that main.css already has strong tap-target (44-48px), overflow-x hidden, smooth scroll, and drawer lock rules. The main gap is: (1) number inputs on Chrome/Safari show spinner controls that interfere with the clean calculator UI and cause layout shift on some devices; (2) the back-to-top button has dead HTML on all pages except bra-size-calculator — the JS is only in one page, so 10+ other pages have a broken button that never appears.

patch_list.issue: Chrome/Safari number inputs show native spinner buttons (up/down arrows) which overlap the calculator input fields and cause layout shift. This is especially bad on the bra-size-calculator page where the two number inputs sit side by side.
patch_list.goal: Remove native number spinners from input[type=number] to prevent layout shift and visual clutter on the calculator form.

patch_list.issue: The back-to-top button was fixed in this page only. But 10+ other pages (articles, best-comfort-bras, best-wireless-bras, about, contact, 404, bra-buying-guide, how-to-measure-bra-size, bra-size-guide sub-pages) still have dead back-to-top HTML with no JS. Moving the JS into classic-ui.js makes it global and fixes all pages at once.
patch_list.old_snippet:
<button id="footerBackToTop" class="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-[#fdf8f5] border border-[#e6d5c3] text-[#8b7355] hover:text-[#6b5344] hover:border-[#6b5344] shadow-md flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300 opacity-0 pointer-events-none" aria-label="Back to top">
      <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
        <polyline points="18 15 12 9 6 15"></polyline>
      </svg>
    </button>
    <script>!function(){var b=document.getElementById('footerBackToTop');if(!b)return;var show=function(){b.classList.toggle('bc-back-to-top-visible',window.scrollY>600);};window.addEventListener('scroll',show,{passive:true});show();b.addEventListener('click',function(){window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});});}();</script>
